articles.summary: Argentina's Nuclear Regulatory Authority and Brazil's Naval Secretariat for Nuclear Safety and Quality aim to develop regulation relating to the use of nuclear reactors on ships.

articles.title: Final unit at Bilibino Nuclear Power Plant permanently shut down
articles.summary: The last of the three operable units at the Bilibino Nuclear Power Plant in Chukotka, Russia, was permanently shut down on 30 December.

articles.title: Fuel loading under way at new Chinese units
articles.summary: The initial loading of fuel assemblies into the cores of unit 1 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant in Guangdong province and unit 1 at the San'ao plant in Zhejiang province - both Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors - has commenced ahead of their start-up, China General Nuclear announced.

articles.title: DOE awards USD2.7 billion to strengthen US uranium enrichment
articles.summary: General Matter, American Centrifuge Operating and Orano Federal Services have each been awarded USD900 million of funding by the US Department of Energy to provide uranium enrichment services. A further USD28 million has been awarded to Global Laser Enrichment to continue advancing next-generation uranium enrichment technology.

articles.title: Agreement extension enables continued development of Polish plant
articles.summary: Polish power company Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has signed an amendment with the Westinghouse-Bechtel Consortium enabling the implementation of the next stage of work under the project to build Poland's first nuclear power plant, as part of the Engineering Development Agreement.

articles.title: Key commissioning tests completed at Tianwan 7
articles.summary: Tests that simulate the temperatures and pressures which the reactor systems will be subjected to during normal operation have been completed at unit 7 of the Tianwan nuclear power plant in China's Jiangsu province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Canadian repository project moves on to review stage
articles.summary: The Initial Project Description for the proposed underground deep geological repository system for Canada's used nuclear fuel has been posted on the Impact Assessment Agency of Canada website, triggering the start of the regulatory process for the facility.

articles.title: Construction milestone at Chinese underground laboratory
articles.summary: Excavation of the spiral ramp of the Beishan Underground Research Laboratory near Jiuquan City in China's Gansu province has been fully completed, China National Nuclear Corporation announced.

articles.title: Third tier of Iran’s Bushehr 2 nuclear power unit installed
articles.summary: The Atomic Energy Organisation of Iran has said that the third tier of the inner containment building of the second unit at the Bushehr nuclear power plant has been installed.

articles.title: Terrestrial Energy, Oklo execute DOE agreements
articles.summary: Terrestrial Energy Inc and Oklo Inc have executed agreements with the US Department of Energy for a pilot reactor that will support Integral Molten Salt Reactor plant development, and a radioisotope pilot plant, respectively.

articles.title: CFS accelerates commercial fusion with Siemens, NVIDIA
articles.summary: US private fusion company Commonwealth Fusion Systems is collaborating with multinational technology companies NVIDIA and Siemens to develop a digital twin of its SPARC prototype fusion machine that will apply artificial intelligence and data and project management tools to accelerate commercial fusion.

articles.title: US NRC approves Limerick digital retrofit project
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has approved what is described as a first-of-a-kind project to replace analogue instrumentation and control equipment with digital systems.

articles.title: Chinese SMR completes non-nuclear steam start up test
articles.summary: The ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project, under construction at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan, successfully passed its non-nuclear turbine test run on the first attempt on 23 December, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Upgrade works for Armenian NPP life extension
articles.summary: Russia’s Rosatom has outlined progress on "further enhancing the plant's safety and reliability, as well as confirming the feasibility of operating" the Armenian Nuclear Power Plant for an extended period.

articles.title: DOE delivers HALEU feedstock for advanced reactor fuel
articles.summary: Standard Nuclear, Inc has received its first shipment of high-assay low-enriched uranium feedstock at its facility in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, under the US Department of Energy's initiative to fast-track the fuel supply chain for advanced reactors.

articles.title: Revised plan for clean-up of Central Asian uranium legacy sites
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has published a new strategic master plan to continue its cooperation with Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan and international organisations on the remediation of uranium legacy sites until 2030.

articles.title: First mobile sorption unit launched by Rosatom
articles.summary: The construction and installation of the first mobile sorption unit at the Verkhne-Uksyanskaya deposit of the Dalmatovskoye uranium deposit is aimed at ensuring optimised uranium production, Rosatom says.

articles.title: Bulk sample programme begins at Tony M mine
articles.summary: The programme will see the extraction of up to 2000 tons of mineralised material to generate real-world mining, processing, and cost data, and is a "decision gate" towards a potential restart decision for IsoEnergy's past-producing uranium mine.

articles.title: Chinese tokamak achieves progress in high-density operation
articles.summary: Experiments at China's Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak have confirmed the existence of "a density-free region" of the tokamak, finding a method to break through the density limit and providing important physical evidence for the high-density operation of magnetic confinement fusion devices.

articles.title: Muroosystems expands nuclear cooperation in Central Asia
articles.summary: Japan's Muroosystems Corporation has signed a memorandum of understanding with UzAtom, Uzbekistan's nuclear development agency, for cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy. The focus of this cooperation is on nuclear safety, regulatory support, technical consulting, and owner's engineering services for nuclear projects.
